messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'd like to pilot a lightweight 'remediation radar' to track postmortem follow-ups and recurring incident signals. Goal: one shared board that answers 'who owns it', 'due when', and 'recurrence risk' so remediations don't slip. Thoughts?

alex: +1. we need strict SLAs on ownership. Suggest 3 buckets: 72h quick fixes, 2-week remediation, and long-term architecture.

joel: Agree on buckets. Also add a small field for 'regression test added?' so we don't just fix prod without preventing recurrence.

maria: Nice. Proposed minimal columns: "Status", "Owner", "Priority (72h/2w/long)", "Due", "Signal (repeat count)", "Mitigation link", "Postmortem link". Keep each row = one action item.

danielle: For comms cadence, can we standardize a 3-point notification: SLACK (ops-incidents), weekly remediation digest to PMs, and a monthly follow-up meeting for long-term items? Short items should not need meetings.

alex: +emoji :thumbsup: For owners: rotate IC as remediation lead for the week? IC rotates independently from oncall; person then shepherds the radar and runs the 30-min weekly sync.

samir: Quick question — how do we classify recurrence risk? Automatic count of incident kinds? Or manual?

sre-bot: [automated] Suggested recurrence signal: increment when an incident with matching primary symptom occurs within 90 days. Current detection coverage ~75%.

joel: Use the bot count as the initial signal, but require human validation before escalation. Bot = signal, not final verdict.

maria: Good. Draft timeline template for remediation lifecycles:

```
- Day 0: Postmortem published, assign remediation owner (within 24h)
- Day 3: Quick-fix verification (if 72h priority) or initial plan published
- Day 7-14: Implementation checkpoint (screenshot PR link / test added)
- Day 30: Long-term design doc / follow-up flagged (if not done)
- 90d: Recurrence review; close or reclassify
```

Can we embed that into the board as a read-only note?

danielle: Yes. Also add a mandatory 'closure note' template (what tests added, which dashboards/alarms updated, who validated). Makes handoff clearer.

alex: For rotation: propose 1-week remediation lead slots, 2 people staggered so handovers are easy. Remediation lead duties: triage radar, nudge owners, run the weekly 30-min sync, and update closure notes.

maria: I'll create the board in Jira/Confluence or a lightweight Trello first? Preference for something we can query via API. Ideas?

joel: If we want API and automation (bot increments, reminders), use a Jira board with custom fields. Con: extra overhead. Trello is fast but clunky to integrate. Notion is readable but hard to automate.

samir: I vote Jira with an API webhook to our bot. We can have the bot post reminders to ops-incidents and add the signal count.

ops-comm: For comms, template for weekly digest (short): top 5 open remediations, owners, blockers, and any items >30d. We can auto-post to #ops-summary and tag PMs for >30d items.

maria: Good. Who wants to own initial pilot (create board + add last 6 postmortems actions)? I can start if someone pairs on automation.

alex: I can pair for the automation MVP (bot->Jira webhook + reminder job). I can do the webhook config this week.

danielle: I'll draft the closure note template and the weekly digest format.

maria: Plan: (1) pilot board in Jira, seeded with last 6 postmortems; (2) remediation lead rotation roster for Q2; (3) automation: bot signals + reminders; (4) closure note + digest templates. Target: pilot live in 3 weeks.

joel: Can we add a 'cost to business' quick field? helps prioritization.

maria: Yes—short numeric scale 1-3. Add that.

samir: I'll surface the bot recurrence algorithm gaps and help tune thresholds before pilot.

sre-bot: [automated] Reminder scheduled: notify #incidents in 72h to confirm owners for all new postmortems.

ops-comm: I'll set the digest channel and add the PM tag list; need a small PR to infra config.

maria: Great. Next step: I'll make a stub Jira project and drop links here tomorrow. If anyone objects to Jira, speak up now. Otherwise we'll start there and iterate.

alex: No objections. excited.

joel: Minor ask — add a periodic audit (quarterly) to ensure closed items didn't reappear. Could be part of 90d recurrence review.

maria: Noted. Thanks all. I'll post the board link and the initial seeded items tomorrow. :rocket:
